_readme: Single source of truth for /founder-portal/. Edit here, run python3 tools/tools_pages.py, push. kind: start | free | kit | install | advisory | event. Optional: sections (list of [title, text]) for a detailed card; noPartner true hides the Retained Partner note. status: live | soon. A kit becomes buyable when stripeLink (https://buy.stripe.com/...) and stripePaymentLinkId (plink_...) are set and its file exists in kits/. Free tools with a file are served from /assets/downloads/. Prices are shown as written. Optional: demo (path to a live demo page) adds a 'See the live demo' button.
